valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 20 Nov 2026. (1) Business: one business in effect, coatings (wood coatings 73% of H1 FY2027 revenue, decoratives 15%; furnishing, brushes and EV chargers the rest: Interim Sep 2026, p. 11), so one sector beta: specialty chemicals. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) could NOT be opened: his site is blocked by this run's network settings. Stand-in from a web-search extract of his global table (January 2026): Chemical (Specialty), 952 firms, unlevered beta corrected for cash 1.04. (3) Relevered with net debt Rs 2.92bn (30 Sep 2026, incl. leases, less cash and short-term deposits) ÷ market value Rs 20.48bn (522.4mn shares × Rs 39.20, CSE close 19 Nov 2026) = 0.14, at the 30% statutory rate (the effective rate is low only while tax losses last): 1.04 × (1 + 0.70 × 0.14) = 1.14. (4) Local 5-year betas: only one found, StockAnalysis 0.46 (5Y, undated web-search extract); TradingView 0.95 and Simply Wall St 0.20 give no period and are ignored. Fewer than the 3 sources the rule asks for. (5) Higher of 1.14 and 0.46 = 1.14. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. (8) Shown in the Required return tile. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's emerging-markets file and three local 5-year betas.

valuationInputs.name: Normal tax rate
valuationInputs.reason: FY2026 effective rate 10% because Rs 0.84bn of tax losses were used; Rs 1.2bn remain, enough for roughly one to two more years. H1 FY2027 16%. Statutory 30% in Sri Lanka, 27.5% Bangladesh, 28% NZ; 25% allows for the remaining losses and the 9% UAE rate.

valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (20 Nov 2026): 8.24% + 1.14 × (4.2% + 6.08%) = 20.0%, ±1.5 points. Replaces the hand-set 20 / 18 / 16.5%.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (20 Nov 2026): cost of debt 8.18% (interest paid 0.286 ÷ average borrowings and leases, FY 2026), tax 10% (effective), debt weight 12.5% (net debt Rs 2.92bn at Sep 2026, market cap Rs 20.48bn at Rs 39.20). Cost of debt about 4 points under the bond yield: short-term import and working-capital loans, some in foreign currency. Used only for the DCF reading.

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 4% / 8% / 12%; supported 12.0% (reinvestment rate 89.1% × return on capital 13.5%, FY 2026). All within 2 pts.
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py on FY 2026. The reinvestment includes the Rs 1.02bn Mirotone purchase; without it the reinvestment rate is about 28%, supporting about 4%, so the base case relies on Mirotone and Bangladesh. Profit kept × ROE gives 11.0%.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE
valuationInputs.reason: ROE 16, 15, 11, 17, 13% over FY2022–26 (average 14.4%); 13.2% on the last 12 months. Used for P/B, justified P/E and residual income.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run growth
valuationInputs.reason: Below the 12.24% bond yield; roughly nominal growth.

valuationInputs.name: EPS to March 2027 × P/E
valuationInputs.reason: H1 EPS Rs 0.95; H2 Rs 1.65 / 2.05 / 2.45 against Rs 2.15 last year (tax rising as losses run out). P/E justified at the cost of equity (payout 1 − growth ÷ ROE), from scripts/valuation.py; was a chosen 8 / 10 / 12x. Base 3% below the Rs 3.10 run-rate (12 months to Sep 2026).

valuationInputs.name: Residual income
valuationInputs.reason: Payout: Rs 0.376bn paid in Sep 2026 on 2025/26 owners profit of Rs 1.51bn.

valuationInputs.name: DCF reading (not weighted)

valuationInputs.reason: Trailing operating profit Rs 1.93bn × (1 − 25% normal tax) = 1.45; start cash less about 0.15 for non-cash gains (investment property revaluation). changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/redo JAT.N0000 full). Research record and analysis rebuilt from the downloaded annual report 2025/26 and interims to June and September 2026: full statements, reinvestment figures, segments, ten-year summary, management and shareholders added. Required return now from the beta (1.14 → 20.0%, was a hand-set 18%), P/E method now uses the justified P/E (4.1x base, was a chosen 10x), so fair value fell from Rs 21.00 to Rs 11.98. Whole-company DCF added as a reading (about Rs 3), not weighted. Business tests 2 of 4 (unchanged): category 3, avoid for now. Beta provisional (stand-in sector beta, one local beta). The 2025/26 dividend per share isn't stated in the reports (about Rs 0.72 worked out).
